notes: Phobos Manufacturing materials: raw stock with real consumers, terminal remainders at the technical minimum price, and mined chunks that clone the game's hydrates. Owner decisions of 29 September 2026; the recovery and pricing rules are in docs/development/manufacturing-refinery-and-chemistry.md. Kinds: stock clones the game's scrap steel, mined clones its hydrates. A material's kg is bound to the recipes that use it: change both or neither.

PhobosNickelIronIngot.notes: Cast nickel-iron, Manufacturing raw stock: 5 cr/kg, above scrap steel and far below the ore (refining value review, 30 September 2026); four plus one carbon carburise into four 25 cr steel ingots.

PhobosCarbonStock.notes: Carbon stock from the carbides charge.

PhobosRefinerySlag.notes: Terminal: sulfide, phosphide and oxide skimmings or a frozen melt.

PhobosClayHydrates.notes: Mined, never sold: a CI-type clay hydrate chunk from C-class finds. Uses the game's hydrate art until it has its own.

PhobosAmmoniumSaltCrust.notes: Mined, never sold: ammonium chloride and sodium carbonate crust of the kind NASA's Dawn mission saw on Ceres; sells like the game's hydrates.

PhobosSpentSaltCake.notes: Terminal: sodium chloride baked into the crust's clay.

PhobosEvaporiteCrust.notes: Mined, never sold: an evaporite-rich piece of a brine vein from C-class finds, after the minerals NASA's OSIRIS-REx team reported in Bennu samples (McCoy et al. 2025); proportions authored. Sells like the game's hydrates.

PhobosPotassiumSulfate.notes: LC-3 product, 60 cr/kg: fertiliser-grade potassium sulfate. Never sold by merchants.

PhobosPhosphateConcentrate.notes: LC-3 intermediate, 48 cr/kg: the crust's wet-separated Na,Mg phosphate, feed for struvite. Priced so the struvite step stays within half again its inputs. Never sold by merchants.

PhobosLeachedResidue.notes: LC-3 intermediate at the technical minimum price: the crust's clay matrix and magnesite, feed for the V4's calcine charge. Not terminal: the V4 takes it.

PhobosStruvite.notes: LC-3 product, about 40 cr/kg: slow-release magnesium ammonium phosphate fertiliser. Never sold by merchants.

PhobosBrineSaltCake.notes: Terminal: the crust's sodium salts (halite, the sodium chloride made, trona, leftover thenardite, villiaumite).

PhobosCausticRemainder.notes: Terminal: the sodium hydroxide left by struvite precipitation.

PhobosCalcinedResidue.notes: Terminal: the leached residue's clay matrix with its magnesite calcined to magnesia.

PhobosSulfideNodule.notes: Mined, never sold: a troilite and schreibersite nodule of the kind found in iron meteorites (Buchwald 1975), carved from the meteoric-iron share of M-class and S-class finds; proportions authored. Sells like the game's hydrates.

PhobosPhosphoricAcidFlask.notes: SA-3 product: 0.515 kg of phosphoric acid in a sealed flask, the phosphorus of three struvite units, feed for the LC-3's acid-route struvite. Never sold by merchants.

PhobosRoastedCalcine.notes: Terminal: the nodule's iron and nickel oxides and silicate after roasting.
